## IHL · LeadMailbox disposition write-back

GHL fires this after each AI call.

**Send in customData:** leadid, stage_name (disposition), summary, transcript_url, recording_url, appointment, note_html.

**Set n8n env vars:** LMB_API_ACCOUNT=IHLI01, LMB_API_KEY=<rotated key> (keeps the secret out of the JSON).

**Confirm before go-live:** (1) STATUS_KEY with Dan, (2) David creates the AI- statuses + picks SALES_BOOKED_STATUS, (3) leadid token from LMB intake.

Unknown disposition or missing leadid -> IF:Ready? false -> no write (safe).
